name: Lydia Wangerin
description: One of the younger Wangerin siblings. JD had an unresolved interest in her in August 2016 that ended with them not talking for several months — she didn't know how to handle it. By summer 2017 the friendship had recovered; she joined JD and Liz for a helicopter ride over Potsdam at the summer festival.
bio: Liz Wangerin's younger sister. JD has known her since 2015 through the Wangerin house. Good friends from May 2017 onward. She married Johnny Martin in May 2024 — JD did their wedding photos.
